data.content_ref: inline:The 'refuted if' condition is tautological and self-immunizing. The claimed contradiction is that installation does not uniformly constrain registry targets (evidenced by 3-of-26 success rate). The proposed refutation condition—'if the same installation ritual reproduces the 3-of-26 ratio on a larger, multi-author repository'—would CONFIRM rather than refute the claim. If a larger repository also shows only 3-of-26 targets failing first, this provides additional evidence that installation fails to uniformly constrain targets (since 23-of-26 still pass), strengthening rather than undermining the original assertion. A genuine refutation would require showing that installation DOES uniformly constrain targets (e.g., a high success rate like 26-of-26 or 25-of-26 on a comparable repository), not reproducing the same failure pattern.
